summary: Stewart Information Services filed an 8-K announcing its board approved raising the annual cash dividend to $2.20 per share from $2.10, effective with the third quarterly payment of 2026, and declared a $0.55 per share Q3 dividend payable September 30, 2026 to holders of record September 15, 2026. The press release, signed by CFO David Hisey and quoting CEO Fred Eppinger, notes this is the seventh increase in under six years. No advisor named. Modest yield-focused capital return; watch payout coverage against title-insurance cyclicality.
